A_cooldown.measured: Black Hole charge refill time = 3.6 s (current build: base recharge 14s, Endless Maw +2s, Recurrence 60%, gear/passive ICR 75.75%, 2 charges)
A_cooldown.conclusion: Recurrence property-70 60% is a multiplicative cooldown-reduction factor (1 - CDR) applied to the adjusted cooldown, while player ICR is a separate (1 + ICR) divisor. The v1 additive ICR-pool formula (6.787s) is rejected.

B_binary.measured: Training dummy total DPS 400k -> 800k when Black Hole Binary System is enabled; user notes the DPS is mostly Ignite
B_binary.conclusion: Binary System +100% is an independent more multiplier on total Black Hole damage (x2 total; Ignite dominates DPS and is also doubled), on top of the structural two-component (fire+cold) split. Ignite inherits the Binary +100% more (user rule 5).

code_cross_check.binary: BlackHoleTree.updateMutator case 'Black Hole Binary Star' sets the binary flag AND constructs Stats.Stat(property=Damage(0), tags=0, increased=0, more=points*1.0); DamageStatsHolder.addBaseDamage is a plain += so the two-star structural copy is real too (evidence: bh-tree-mutator-effects-1.5.3.json).
code_cross_check.ignite_inheritance: AilmentReceiver.ApplyAilment builds the ailment stats from the applying ability mutator and takes a Stats increases object (RVA 0x2832d40); the Binary more stat therefore reaches Ignite (evidence: README section 10/9).
code_cross_check.cooldown: BlackHoleMutator.getChargeRegen override divides the base recharge rate by (1 - blackHoleReducedCooldown); Recurrence node data property 70 Cooldown Reduction (evidence: cooldown-charge-1.5.3.json).
